snippet.title: Aikyam - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description:
Dazzle the hearts of disgruntled villagers with extravagant turn-based battles and rally them against demons in this Bollywood-inspired fantasy RPG!
Aikyam will be available on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Steam.
